name: Tocaya Modern Mexican
notes: 5 photos reviewed. Photos 1-2 are Happy Hour drink boards (beer/wine/margaritas, drink-only, skipped). Photos 3-4 are a digital menu board (Tacos, Burritos, Bowls, Quesadillas, Soups, Sides, Desserts) and are the source for all dishes below. Photo 5 shows a separate printed Salads/Bowls/Tacos/Burritos board with conflicting prices for several overlapping items (e.g. Keto Bowl $13.95 vs $15.35, Burrito Mexicano $9.35 vs $12.45); treated as a superseded/duplicate menu and excluded to avoid mixing conflicting prices.
